text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text: Yaaass, honey! City, you are gorgeous!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Thank you. Should we do another angle?

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do more! For the next scene,
can we see
a stunning run beside the
waves?

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
I love it! I love it! Absolutely
gorgeous! ♪ Let's
keep the flow going!
The next one is...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaand we are done! Good job! ☆ You
can look
forward to the finished
product! ♪

Having lost themselves in the moment,
the
photographer and Gold City keep
going longer
than planned. In the end,
she's exhausted.
